name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, captivated by the roar of engines and the strategic dance of drivers on the track. Growing up in Shanghai, he immersed himself in local racing events, fueling a dream to contribute to the sport beyond spectating. After completing a degree in Communications, Li joined Hot Car Competições, eager to translate his academic knowledge into real-world impact. 

Li's approach to public relations is meticulous and data-driven. He believes in crafting authentic narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike, focusing on the human stories behind the high-octane action. His dedication to detail and understanding of the Chinese market make him a valuable asset to the team, bridging the gap between the team's global ambitions and local fan engagement.

What sets Li apart is his uncanny ability to predict social media trends and tailor content accordingly. He's always one step ahead, ensuring Hot Car Competições remains relevant and engaging in an ever-evolving digital landscape. He aims to make the team a household name in China and beyond.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Li has a slender build and a focused gaze, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a lucky red envelope with him to races.
Obsessively organizes his desk, even at the racetrack.
Prefers communicating through meticulously crafted emails rather than quick chats.
